description: Composable governance for adaptive decisions, causal attribution, problem discovery, frontend delivery, planning, Git, resource observation, optional code intelligence, validation, long-running project continuity, project truth, archive curation, and reporting.

defaultPrompt: Use $work-governance:work-lifecycle to align evidence and authority, then adapt execution at meaningful change.
interface.longDescription: Work Governance helps Codex align goals, evidence, decisions, and authority before acting; confirm the real cause of an observed symptom before changing anything; design risk-driven validation that exposes important problems early; connect frontend references, required behavior, product copy, and acceptance evidence; adapt execution when semantic events change the route; use Plans only when valuable; protect Git and action boundaries; establish optional structural code intelligence safely; keep long-running project development recoverable; assess and record consumption without invented development budgets; validate proportionally; and report work completely. Explicit decision delegation remains bounded, core policy stays independent of storage and tool choices, and optional adapters activate only for matching scenarios.
interface.shortDescription: Adaptive governance with optional tool adapters.

name: work-governance
